desc: Design feasibility check `ok(H)`: L_i = max(0, H − D_i), upper A_i = min(U_i, H); propagate A forward/backward with X; feasible iff L_i ≤ A_i for all i.
Establish monotonicity of feasibility in H and binary search range: lo = 0 (always feasible), hi = min(U_i + D_i).
Confirm complexity: ~31 × O(N) ≈ 6.2e6 ops, fine in Python with micro-optimizations.
Answer formula: total = sum(U_i + D_i) − N·H_max; Python ints handle 64-bit.
Implement solve() with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), fused loops for speed.

Verify against samples: sample 1 → 15, sample 2 → 0, sample 3 → 5999999994, sample 4 → 9460 (algorithm matches known-correct pattern); edge cases (H=0 feasible, negative lowers clamped, upper bound min(U_i, H) ensures d_i ≥ 0) all handled in code.
